description: Create a short-lived signed URL for one image, video, or audio reference. Upload bytes to signedUrl with the declared Content-Type, then call playground_media_upload_complete. The URL is scoped to your user, project, and OAuth client. For a file attached in chat, prefer playground_asset_import with file. If your environment cannot reach signedUrl, stop and ask the user to choose Add image on the Berrys canvas (playground_canvas_open) instead of retrying. Returns an upload ID, signed upload URL, MIME type, byte limit and expiry.

filename.description: Original filename of the media being uploaded, including its extension.

mimeType.description: Media content type of the bytes to upload, such as image/png.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

name: playground_media_upload_begin
title: Start a Playground reference upload
